description: A focused article with four substantial H1 sections and a direct conclusion.
writing_guidance: Move quickly from context to useful guidance. Avoid repetition, filler, and unnecessary background.

sections.purpose: Introduce the topic, reader problem, and practical promise of the article.
sections.heading_instruction: Use the article title as the first heading.
sections.content_instruction: Orient the reader and explain what they will learn.

sections.purpose: Explain the central idea and why it matters.
sections.heading_instruction: Write a descriptive heading specific to the topic.
sections.content_instruction: Give the reader clear context, definitions, and decision factors.

sections.purpose: Turn the explanation into practical actions or recommendations.
sections.content_instruction: Provide useful steps, examples, considerations, or a compact checklist.

sections.purpose: Summarize the takeaway and give the reader a sensible next step.
sections.heading_instruction: Use a conclusion heading tied to the topic rather than the word Conclusion alone.
sections.content_instruction: Close decisively without introducing an unrelated idea.
